provenance.section_title: Section 3: Prevention and Treatment of AKI - Growth Factors, Nephrotoxic Agents, and Surgery

rules.rationale: Recommends NOT using rhIGF-1 to prevent or treat AKI.
rules.citation: Chapter 3.6.1: Recommend NOT using recombinant human (rh)IGF-1 [SNOMED: 5699003] to prevent or treat AKI (1B).

provenance.section_title: Section 3: Prevention and Treatment of AKI - Growth Factors, Nephrotoxic Agents, and Surgery

rules.rationale: A single dose of theophylline may be given in neonates with severe perinatal asphyxia at high risk of AKI.
rules.citation: Chapter 3.7.1: A single dose [SNOMED: 408102007] of theophylline [SNOMED: 372810006] may be given [SNOMED: 419582001] in neonates [SNOMED: 255407002] with severe [SNOMED: 24484000] perinatal asphyxia [SNOMED: 281578009] at high risk of AKI [SNOMED: 14669001] (2B).

provenance.section_title: Section 3: Prevention and Treatment of AKI - Growth Factors, Nephrotoxic Agents, and Surgery

rules.rationale: Suggest NOT using aminoglycosides unless no suitable, less nephrotoxic therapeutic alternatives are available.
rules.citation: Chapter 3.8.1: Suggest NOT using aminoglycosides [SNOMED: 763805006] unless no suitable, less nephrotoxic therapeutic alternatives are available (2A).

rules.rationale: Administer aminoglycosides as a single daily dose rather than multiple daily doses in patients with normal stable renal function.
rules.citation: Chapter 3.8.2: Administer [SNOMED: 738990001] aminoglycosides [SNOMED: 763805006] as a single daily dose [SNOMED: 408102007] rather than multiple daily doses in patients with normal stable [SNOMED: 58158008] renal function [SNOMED: 11953005] (2B).

provenance.section_title: Section 3: Prevention and Treatment of AKI - Growth Factors, Nephrotoxic Agents, and Surgery

rules.rationale: Suggest using lipid formulations of amphotericin B over conventional formulations.
rules.citation: Chapter 3.8.6: Suggest lipid formulations of amphotericin B [SNOMED: 77703004] over conventional [SNOMED: 255333006] formulations (2A).

rules.rationale: Recommend azoles or echinocandins over conventional amphotericin B for systemic mycoses.
rules.citation: Chapter 3.8.7: Recommend azoles [SNOMED: 300903003] or echinocandins [SNOMED: 373570003] over conventional [SNOMED: 255333006] amphotericin B [SNOMED: 77703004] for systemic [SNOMED: 31099001] mycoses [SNOMED: 3218000] (1A).
